long_opportunity.scope: long-side entry opportunity only; short-side scoring is intentionally not enabled
long_opportunity.stars: 1-5 measures entry opportunity/freshness, NOT bullish trend strength
long_opportunity.T0: latest HA still purple; wait for yellow
long_opportunity.T1: yellow appeared but has not exceeded the second-last purple HA step
long_opportunity.T2: yellow appeared and exceeded the second-last purple HA step
long_opportunity.midline_regime: rising / flat / flattening / falling based on recent 5d slope and prior 5d deceleration
long_opportunity.one_star_note: one star is not failure; it can mean mature expansion / do-not-chase or otherwise poor long entry timing
